title: Vilakazi Street Makers Market
description: Local designers, crafters and food stalls line the street. Beadwork, prints, shweshwe and fresh vetkoek.
venue: Vilakazi Street, near the Mandela House

title: Pricing for Profit: Kasi Business Workshop
description: A practical two-hour session on costing, pricing and cash flow for small businesses. Bring your numbers.

title: June 16 Route Heritage Walk
description: Walk the 1976 student route with a guide who grew up in Orlando West. Ends at the Hector Pieterson Memorial.
venue: Meet at Morris Isaacson High School gate

title: Emdeni Street Bash: Amapiano Edition
description: Emdeni DJ Hire brings the full sound system. Local selectors, dance battles and food trucks.

title: Shisanyama Sunday at Sakhumzi
description: Sunday platters, a live DJ from 14:00 and the best people-watching on Vilakazi Street.

title: Meadowlands Stokvel Circle Meetup
description: Monthly meetup for stokvel and savings-club members. This month: bulk buying for December and safe record keeping.

title: Jabavu Early Morning Fresh Market
description: Farmers and traders bring fresh vegetables and fruit in bulk. Come early for the best prices.
venue: Jabavu market, under the green shade cloth

title: Freedom Charter Bicycle Ride
description: A guided bicycle ride through Kliptown and the Freedom Charter story. Bikes and helmets included.

title: Marketing on WhatsApp: Hands-on Session
description: Set up WhatsApp Business, catalogues and broadcast lists that customers actually read. Bring your phone.

title: Moroka Dam Family Braai Day
description: Bring the family to the dam. Buy your meat on site and we braai it for you. Jumping castle for the kids.

title: Soweto Designers Pop-up Market
description: Twenty local labels under one roof. Streetwear, accessories and made-to-measure orders.

title: Chesa Nyama Saturday with DJ Sets
description: Big-group tables, kids play area and back-to-back DJ sets until sunset.

title: Sunday Jazz at Dube Village Lounge
description: Live quartet playing township jazz standards. Relaxed, grown-up crowd. Over 18 only.

title: Grow Your Stokvel: Savings Bootcamp
description: How to move your club savings into a group account, set rules everyone agrees on and plan payouts.

title: Regina Mundi Church Heritage Tour
description: A quiet tour of the church that sheltered students in 1976, including the bullet marks and the Black Madonna.

title: Load-shedding Proofing Your Business
description: Inverters, batteries and gas: what each costs to run and how to size backup power for your shop.

title: Naledi Music Academy Spring Concert
description: Piano, guitar and choir students perform for family and friends. Tea and scones after the show.

title: December Grocery Stokvel Planning
description: Plan the December bulk buy together. Wholesale suppliers will quote on the day.
